title: FG6 WordPress cluster photo-filter listing
description: Opt-in min_photos listing contract. Local projection returns a filtered window total. A bare-list recognition producer has no total; WordPress reports null until the end can be established from a non-empty page or an empty first page. A bounded same-filter lookahead establishes truncated. Older uncomputed photo_count fields may be absent; neither absence nor null is a face count.

photo_count.description: Distinct actual media/attachment identities across the complete member set, independent of identity_count and face_count. Null means the aggregate is unavailable.

person_uuid.description: Only the local WordPress person binding establishes this identity. The remote recognition path emits null.

total.description: Exact filtered total when established, otherwise null. Never the page length as a substitute for the total.

truncated.description: Additional matching rows exist after offset plus this page.

min_photos.description: Optional query minimum after strict raw integer parsing. Omission applies no photo filter; an explicitly empty, null, fractional, boolean, array, or out-of-range value is HTTP 400.
